resources.string: The app language and question language are saved separately. Changing a language reloads the quiz page. Changing the question language opens a different question collection. Unavailable question translations are not replaced with another language.

Walk between questions and answer them on your phone. Tipspromenad is suitable for events, team activities and time with friends.

This version loads questions from a website and requires internet access. You can also play in your browser: Open the quiz website.

Choose the app language and question language separately in Language settings. If a question collection is unavailable in your chosen language, the website will let you know.
Find more apps and games from the developer on Google Play: Nilsson82 on Google Play.
